## Change

Describe the behaviour change and link the relevant issue.

## Validation

Record commands, actual results, OS/architecture and Go/Git versions. Name any unavailable or skipped checks.

- [ ] Regression test observed failing before the fix, where applicable.
- [ ] `go run ./tools/dev validate` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples match implemented behaviour.
- [ ] No private fixtures, credentials, generated binaries or internal handovers are included.
- [ ] State/CLI compatibility and destructive-operation implications are documented.

## Risk

Explain any effect on ownership, journals, shared targets, conflict baselines or the main checkout.
